findings: Same-game native FEX report has a validated startup workaround, not a confirmed OHOS root cause or upstream code fix.

Default scalar TSO=true is not proof of effective per-app configuration; capture overrides before forcing more switches.
Godot native hosting bypasses the ordinary Main startup-hook path; previous uninitialized probe cannot exclude managed exceptions.
